feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: England declared severe drought across six regions as reservoirs fell to near-record lows
entry.summary: The government declared severe drought in parts of Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, Somerset, East Sussex and West Sussex on 15 October. — Sources: UK Environment Agency, Dry weather and drought in England, 9-15 October 2026, updated 16 October 2026

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub doubled in a day as its recovery from the river's record low continued
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge at Kaub read 20 centimetres at 06:30 on 20 October, up from 10 centimetres at the same hour the day before. — Sources: Pegelonline (Wasserstrassen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung), direct fetch, 20 October 2026

entry.title: A cold front brought the US its first widespread frost of the season
entry.summary: Freeze watches covered Wisconsin and the New York-New Jersey-Connecticut region, with a frost advisory for the Minneapolis area forecasting temperatures as low as 34 degrees Fahrenheit, as a cold front swept through the country. — Sources: National Weather Service, via local affiliate reporting, 17-19 October 2026

entry.title: Washington State's Yakima Basin reservoirs fell to about 8 percent of capacity
entry.summary: The basin's five reservoirs sit at roughly a quarter of their typical volume for this time of year. State water-use restrictions covering the basin remain in force through 31 October. — Sources: Washington State Department of Ecology

entry.title: Singapore's haze eased only briefly before its PSI climbed back up
entry.summary: Singapore's west region 24-hour PSI fell from 227 to 122 between 18 and 19 October, then rose back to 130 by midday on 20 October. — Sources: National Environment Agency, real-time PSI data, direct fetch, 20 October 2026
